### blue_signal (optional)

Blue color-component input for lamps, or blue-state output for chain signals. Unknown fields are refused. rail_chain_signal_only: Available only on chain signals. Ordinary rail signals cannot read or write this field. Explicit root patch clear: accepted with native reset and readback.
